text: One day, a man and a woman wish for a child. They want a child even if they turn out so small that they are no bigger than a thumb.
Their wish comes true and they have a baby boy who is tiny, just the size of a thumb. They name him Tom Thumb.
Tom stayed tiny, but he is smart and fast.
One day, Tom decides to set a goal.
When setting goals, it is important to ensure that they are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound.

The next day, two strangers see Tom Thumb and think they can make money by showing him in town.
They offer to buy him from his father.
Tom overhears this and decides to go with the strangers. He promises his father that he will come back soon.
He quickly sees that this was a bad decision! You should not go with strangers.
He runs away from them, sneaking into a mouse hole to escape.
As the men look for him, he uses his voice to trick them and make them believe he is still in the mouse hole.
He then finds an empty snail shell and uses it to sleep in.
The next day, Tom finds himself in even more trouble. He got swallowed by a cow and is inside its stomach.
